changelog: New spoken-punctuation temperature units: with Spoken Punctuation on, say 'degree celsius' (or 'ডিগ্রি সেলসিয়াস') while dictating and °C attaches to the previous word ('thirty degree celsius' → 'thirty°C'), 'degree fahrenheit' → °F — for dictating weather, fever and cooking heat instead of typing °C/°F by hand. A bare 'celsius' or 'সেলসিয়াস' still types as a word. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message.
